'''Michele Benzi''' (born 1962  in [[Bologna]]) is an Italian mathematician who works as a full professor in the [[Scuola Normale Superiore]] in [[Pisa]]. He is known for his contributions to [[numerical linear algebra]] and its applications, especially to the solution of [[sparse matrix|sparse]] [[linear systems]] and the study of [[preconditioners]].<ref name="siamfellow">{{Cite web |title=SIAM {{!}} Fellows |url=https://www.siam.org/prizes-recognition/fellows-program/all-siam-fellows/b |access-date=2022-07-15 |website=www.siam.org}}</ref>

== Previous career ==

He worked as assistant professor at the [[University of Bologna]] from 1993 to 1996, then at {{ill|Cerfacs|fr}} in Toulouse from 1996 to 1997, and then at the [[Los Alamos National Laboratory]] for three years.

He transferred to the [[Emory University]] in Atlanta in 2000, where he held the [[endowed chair]] of [[Samuel Candler Dobbs]] professor<ref name="ae"/> starting from 2012 to 2018. Subsequently, he moved back to Italy to the [[Scuola Normale Superiore]] in Pisa as a full professor.

== Awards ==

Benzi was named a [[SIAM Fellow]] in 2012,<ref name="siamfellow" /> and a fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]] in 2018 "for his contributions in numerical linear algebra, exposition, and service to the profession".<ref>{{Cite web |title=Fellows of the American Mathematical Society |url=http://www.ams.org/cgi-bin/fellows/fellows.cgi |access-date=2022-07-15 |website=American Mathematical Society |language=en}}</ref> 
He was elected as a member of [[Academia Europaea]] in 2019.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Academy of Europe: Benzi Michele |url=https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Benzi_Michele |access-date=2024-01-12 |website=www.ae-info.org}}</ref>

As of 2022, he is the [[editor in chief]] of the [[SIAM Journal on Matrix Analysis and Applications]], and he is editor of approximately 20 journals.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Academy of Europe: CV |url=https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Benzi_Michele/CV |access-date=2022-07-20 |website=www.ae-info.org}}</ref> He won a SIAM Outstanding Paper Prize in 2001.<ref>{{Cite web |title=SIAM Outstanding Paper Prizes |url=https://www.siam.org/prizes-recognition/major-prizes-lectures/detail/siam-outstanding-paper-prizes |access-date=2022-07-20 |website=SIAM |language=en-US}}</ref>

== Selected publications ==

* ''Numerical solution of saddle point problems''. M Benzi, [[Gene H. Golub|GH Golub]], J Liesen. Acta Numerica 14, 1-137
* ''Preconditioning techniques for large linear systems: a survey''. M Benzi. Journal of Computational Physics 182 (2), 418-477
* ''A preconditioner for generalized saddle point problems.'' M Benzi, GH Golub. SIAM Journal on Matrix Analysis and Applications 26 (1), 20-41
* ''The physics of communicability in complex networks''. E Estrada, N Hatano, M Benzi. Physics Reports 514 (3), 89-119
